site.metaTitle: SwapSpot - Fumana Uncedo Oluthembekileyo Kufutshane Nawe
site.metaDescription: Bhukisha abancedisi basekuhlaleni abathembekileyo bokucoca, ukulungisa, ubuhle, ukonga ingca, ukuhambisa impahla, ukhathalelo lwezilwanyana, ukhathalelo lwabadala, ukufundisa nokunye.
site.hero.body: Bhukisha ukucoca, ukulungisa, ubuhle, ukonga ingca, uncedo lokuhambisa, ukhathalelo lwezilwanyana nokunye kwimarike enye yasekuhlaleni.
site.hero.rating: evela kubamelwane abangama-2,300+ · abancedisi abangama-1,200 abakufutshane
site.hero.review: Ndibhukishe umlungisi osezantsi kwesitrato kwimizuzu emi-10.
site.how.title: Uncedo lukhona ngokucofa kathathu kuphela
site.how.body: Ukusuka kwi-'Ndifuna oku kwenziwe' ukuya ekubhukisheni, ngaphandle kweefowuni ezingapheliyo, ukuqikelela, okanye iikhowuthi ezingacacanga.
site.steps.0.1: Bona abancedisi basekuhlaleni abathembekileyo kwimephu ephilayo, bacwangciswe ngomgama nesilinganiso.
site.steps.1.1: Khangela iiprofayile, iinkonzo, namaxabiso acacileyo ngaphambi kokuzibophelela.
site.steps.2.1: Thumela imiyalezo, fumana ikhowuthi, ubhukishe ngaphakathi kwi-app. Intlawulo yomsebenzi icwangciswa ngokuthe ngqo nomncedisi.
site.helpers.title: Guqula izakhono zakho zibe ngumvuzo wasekuhlaleni
site.helpers.body: Setha kube kanye uqalise ukubhukishwa ngabamelwane abasele bedinga kanye le nto uyenzayo.
site.helpers.freeBody: Gcina i-100% yento oyizuzayo. I-SwapSpot ayithathi khomishini, pesenti, okanye intlawulo yokukhokela.
site.perks.0.1: Bhala uluhlu lwezakhono zakho, iifoto, nendawo yokusebenza ngemizuzu.
site.perks.1.1: Wena ulawula amaxabiso, irediyasi, neshedyuli yakho.
site.perks.2.1: Fumana izicelo ezikufutshane uphendule ngeekhowuthi ezikhethekileyo.
site.perks.3.1: Fumana izilinganiso ezijika imisebenzi yokuqala ibe ngamakliyenti rhoqo.
site.categories.title: Nokuba ngowuphi umsebenzi, kukho umncedisi
site.categories.body: Iindidi ezisemgangathweni zeenkonzo zasekuhlaleni ekuqaleni, kwaye ezinye ziyongezwa njengoko imarike nganye ikhula.
site.trust.title: Yakhelwe ukuvakalelwa ukhuselekile macala omabini
site.trust.body: Uphononongo lokwenyani, imiyalezo yangasese, nolawulo olugcina abamelwane belawula idatha yabo.
site.trustItems.0.1: Izilinganiso zokwenyani ezivela kubamelwane bokwenyani emva komsebenzi ngamnye.
site.trustItems.2.1: Phawula okanye uthintele nawuphi na umsebenzisi nanini na.
site.trustItems.3.1: Cima i-akhawunti yakho nedatha nanini na ukhetha.
site.trustItems.4.1: Abancedisi bayalawula ukuba indawo yabo iboniswa njani.
site.waitlist.title: Landa i-SwapSpot namhlanje
site.waitlist.body: Khangela abancedisi abakufutshane simahla. Sebenzisa ipasi xa sele ulungele ukuthumela imiyalezo, ukucela iikhowuthi, okanye ukubhukisha.
site.waitlist.noSpam: Landa i-app, ukhangele abancedisi, uqale xa sele ulungile.

site.download.body: Khangela abancedisi abakufutshane simahla. Sebenzisa ipasi xa sele ulungele ukuthumela imiyalezo, ukucela iikhowuthi, okanye ukubhukisha.

directory.indexMetaDescription: Khangela amaphepha oluntu eenkonzo ze-SwapSpot ngodidi nemarike yasekuhlaleni. Fumana ukucoca, ukulungisa, ukuhambisa, ukufundisa, ukhathalelo lwezilwanyana, ubuhle, iinkonzo zobungcali nokunye.
directory.indexIntro: La maphepha enziwa kwiinkonzo ezipapashiweyo zabancedisi kwi-SwapSpot. Anceda amakliyenti afumane izijongelo zeenkonzo zokwenyani ngesixeko, ikhowudi yeposi, ummandla, udidi, ixabiso, ulwimi nesilinganiso.
directory.byCountryBody: Ikhonkco ngalinye elingezantsi livula iphepha loluntu. Xa umncedisi epapasha indawo entsha yokusebenza, ivela apha emva kokuba inkumbulo yesayithi ihlaziyiwe.
directory.emptyBody: Uluhlu lwakhiwe kwiinkonzo ezipapashiweyo zabancedisi. Ukuba akukho makhonkco avelayo apha okwangoku, buyela kungekudala okanye uvule i-app ukukhangela abancedisi abakufutshane nawe.
directory.pairMetaDescription: Fumana abancedisi e-{market} kudidi: {categoryLower}. Qhathanisa izijongelo zeenkonzo zoluntu, iindawo zokusebenza, amaxabiso, iilwimi nezilinganiso ngaphambi kokuvula i-SwapSpot.
directory.pairOgDescription: Khangela iinkonzo zasekuhlaleni (udidi: {categoryLower}) kufutshane ne-{market} uqhubeke kwi-app ye-SwapSpot.
directory.pairSummaryEmpty: I-SwapSpot ilungiselela izijongelo zabancedisi (udidi: {categoryLower}) e-{market}. Vula i-app ukukhangela abancedisi abakufutshane, uqhathanise iindawo zokusebenza, ucele iikhowuthi.
directory.pairSummary: Qhathanisa izijongelo zeenkonzo zoluntu (udidi: {categoryLower}) ezivela kubancedisi basekuhlaleni abajikeleze {market}. Sebenzisa i-app xa sele ulungele ukuthumela umyalezo, ukucela ikhowuthi, okanye ukubhukisha.
directory.popularBody: Ezi nkonzo zivela kwiiprofayile zabancedisi ezipapashiweyo, hayi uluhlu lwentengiso olungatshintshiyo.
directory.areaBody: Amaphepha oluntu abonisa imimandla, iikhowudi zeposi, izixeko nerediyasi yenkonzo ukuze amakliyenti afumane uncedo olukufutshane engabonisi iidilesi ezizimele.
directory.namesBody: Iinkonzo zabancedisi zilungiswa zibe zizihloko ezinokukhangelwa, amagama asekuhlaleni namaphepha eendidi ukuze amakliyenti akhangele ngemisebenzi yokwenyani awayidingayo.
directory.inAppBody: Iwebhusayithi incedisa abantu ukufumana iinkonzo. I-SwapSpot igcina iikhowuthi, imiyalezo, ukubhukisha, uphononongo nolawulo lokhuseleko ngaphakathi kwi-app yeselula.
directory.pairFaq1A: Eli phepha lewebhusayithi lisisijongelo soluntu sokufumana iinkonzo. Landa i-SwapSpot ukuze uthumele imiyalezo kubancedisi, ucele iikhowuthi, wabelane ngeedilesi ezichanekileyo, ulawule ukubhukisha.
directory.pairFaq2A: Hayi. I-SwapSpot ibonisa iindawo zokusebenza ezilinganiselweyo njengeekhowudi zeposi, imimandla, izixeko, okanye irediyasi. Iidilesi ezichanekileyo zihlala zizimele kwaye zinokwabelwana ngazo kwincoko kuphela xa omabini amacala elungile.
directory.pairFaq3A: Hayi. Abancedisi banokwenza iprofayile balistishe iinkonzo ngaphandle kwekhomishini okanye intlawulo yepesenti ye-SwapSpot. Amakliyenti ahlawula ukufikelela xa efuna ukuthumela imiyalezo, ukucela iikhowuthi, okanye ukubhukisha.
directory.pairListDescription: Izijongelo zoluntu zeenkonzo (udidi: {categoryLower}) ezifumanekayo nge-SwapSpot e-{market}.
directory.cardsEmptyBody: I-SwapSpot ivula iiprofayile zabancedisi basekuhlaleni ngemarike. Landa i-app ukubona iinkonzo ezikufutshane, uqhathanise amaxabiso, uthumele imiyalezo kubancedisi xa sele ulungile.
directory.cardsBody: Qhathanisa iinkonzo, amaxabiso, iindawo, iilwimi, izilinganiso namava abancedisi kufutshane ne-{market}. Iidilesi ezichanekileyo noqhagamshelwano oluthe ngqo zihlala ngaphakathi kwi-SwapSpot.
directory.cardNoDescription: Jonga esi sijongelo senkonzo kwi-SwapSpot, uze uvule i-app ukuthumela umyalezo, ukucela ikhowuthi, okanye ukubhukisha.

directory.previewBody: Qhathanisa iinkonzo apha, uze uthumele umyalezo ubhukishe ngaphakathi kwi-app.
directory.noCommissionBody: Abancedisi bagcina intlawulo yemisebenzi. I-SwapSpot ayithathi pesenti okanye ikhomishini kumsebenzi womncedisi.
directory.servicesBody: Ezi zizijongelo zeenkonzo ezipapashiweyo ezivela kwi-SwapSpot. Amaxabiso anokuba lawo amiselweyo, ngeyure, aqala ku-, okanye ngesicelo kuxhomekeke kumsebenzi.
directory.serviceFallback: Vula i-SwapSpot ukubona le nkonzo, ucele iinkcukacha, uqinisekise ubungakanani ngaphambi kokubhukisha.
directory.areasBody: Amaphepha oluntu abancedisi anika iinjini zokukhangela namakliyenti imeko eyaneleyo: amagama eenkonzo, imimandla, izixeko, iindawo ezilinganiselweyo, neempawu zolwimi. Iinkcukacha ezichanekileyo zoqhagamshelwano zihlala ngaphakathi kwi-SwapSpot.

directory.helperFaq2A: Hayi. Amaphepha oluntu abonisa iindawo zokusebenza ezilinganiselweyo njengemimandla, izixeko, iikhowudi zeposi, okanye irediyasi. Iidilesi ezichanekileyo zihlala zizimele de abasebenzisi bazabelane ngazo kwincoko.
directory.helperFaq3A: Hayi. Abancedisi banokulistisha iinkonzo ngaphandle kokuba i-SwapSpot ithathe ikhomishini okanye ipesenti kwiintlawulo zemisebenzi yabo.

pricing.title: Khangela simahla. Sebenzisa ipasi xa sele ulungele ukuqhubeka.
pricing.body: Amakliyenti anokukhangela iindidi aqhathanise abancedisi ngaphandle kokuhlawula. Ipasi iyafuneka ukuthumela imiyalezo, ukucela ikhowuthi, okanye ukubhukisha umncedisi. Intlawulo yomsebenzi ngokwayo icwangciswa ngokuthe ngqo nomncedisi.

pricing.plans.1.note: Ilungele iimfuno eziqhelekileyo zekhaya, zosapho, zokuqesha, okanye zeshishini.

passPrice.referenceNote: Ixabiso lesalathiso. I-App Store okanye Google Play ibonisa ixabiso lokugqibela.

staticPages.intro: Eli phepha lifumaneka ngolwimi olukhethileyo. Kwimibuzo yezomthetho okanye ephathelele i-akhawunti, unxibelelane ne-hello@swapspot.org.

forClients.title: Yenza umsebenzi ngaphandle kokukhasa abantu
forClients.body: Vula i-app, bona ukuba ngubani okufutshane, qhathanisa iiprofayile zokwenyani, thumela imiyalezo ngaphakathi kwi-SwapSpot, ubhukishe xa kuvakala kulungile.
forClients.cards.1.1: Bona iiprofayile, amaxabiso, uphononongo, iifoto neenkonzo.
forClients.cards.2.1: Buza imibuzo, qinisekisa iinkcukacha, uqhubeke uzicwangcisile iikhowuthi.
forClients.cards.3.1: Sebenzisa uphononongo, iingxelo, ukuthintela nolawulo lwe-akhawunti xa kufuneka.
cookieConsent.title: Ukhetho lwakho lobumfihlo
cookieConsent.body: Sisebenzisa iikuki ze-Google Analytics ukuqonda utyelelo nokuphucula i-SwapSpot. Unokwamkela okanye ukwala iikuki zohlalutyo ezikhethekayo.
maintenance.text: I-SwapSpot iyafudukela kwiiseva ezintsha. Malunga neyure enye, ukungena, ukumisela kwakhona iphasiwedi notshintsho lwe-akhawunti kusenokungasebenzi. Nceda uzame kwakhona kamva kancinci.
reset.title: Misela kwakhona iphasiwedi yakho
reset.intro: Khetha iphasiwedi entsha, uze ungene kwi-app ye-SwapSpot usebenzisa i-imeyile yakho nephasiwedi entsha.
reset.done: Iphasiwedi yakho itshintshiwe. Vula i-app ye-SwapSpot ungene.
reset.invalid: Eli khonkco alisebenzi okanye liphelelwe lixesha. Cela elitsha kwi-app.
reset.openLink: Vula ikhonkco lokumisela kwi-imeyile yakho ukuze uqhubeke.
reset.unavailable: Ukumisela kwakhona iphasiwedi akukafumaneki kule sayithi okwangoku.
